import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = '/var/lib/smarthome/hub.db'

@dataclass
class DeleteRoutineResult:
    routine_id: str
    deleted: bool
    triggers_removed: int

@function_tool
def delete_automation_routine(routine_id: str) -> DeleteRoutineResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM routine_triggers WHERE routine_id = ?', (routine_id,))
        triggers_removed = cur.rowcount
        # Revoke any user sharing/access grants tied to this routine
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM routine_permissions WHERE routine_id = ?', (routine_id,))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM routine_shares WHERE routine_id = ?', (routine_id,))
        cur.execute('DELETE FROM routines WHERE id = ?', (routine_id,))
        deleted = cur.rowcount > 0
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return DeleteRoutineResult(routine_id=routine_id, deleted=deleted, triggers_removed=triggers_removed)
